slides.title: Welcome

kind.alt: A course author smiles at a large screen full of slide cards, pictures and a video.

kind.text: Six short stops show what a CourseCraft course can do: media, layers, motion, markers, questions and results.

slides.notes: Start Tour goes to the video slide, so Start Tour › Play Video plays a video in two clicks.

slides.title: Video and sound

kind.text: Video and sound play inside the slide. A trigger starts them, and another reacts when they end.
Play, pause and seek from triggers
A sound effect on any click

slides.notes: Play Video starts the clip with play_media. When it ends, a media_ends trigger changes the status pill and shows a layer.

text.text: The video ended, so a trigger showed this layer.

slides.title: Layers, states and variables

text.text: Select a card to see what it does

kind.text: Select each card. The counter is a variable shown in the text.

kind.alt: Translucent slide cards stacked on top of each other.

slides.notes: Each card shows its layer, switches to its Visited state and counts itself once in the explored variable.

kind.text: A layer sits on top of the slide. Show it with a trigger to add feedback, a pop-up or a new step without leaving the slide.
A state changes how one object looks: hover, selected, visited or any state you name. These cards use three of them.
A variable remembers a value. This one counts the cards you open and shows the total in the text below.

slides.title: Entrances, paths and transitions

kind.text: Every tile below enters with a different effect. This slide arrived with a zoom transition.

objects.name: Moving star
objects.description: A star that moves along a motion path

slides.notes: Five tiles, five entrance effects. Move it runs a motion path; Replay jumps back to this slide (revisit: reset).

slides.title: Markers on a picture

kind.text: Select each marker to open it. Markers are a quick way to label a picture.

kind.alt: An illustrated campus map with a library, a cafe, a round science lab and a park with a pond.

kind.title: Library
kind.body: Quiet study rooms and the help desk.

kind.title: Cafe
kind.body: Coffee, lunch and the best seats outside.

kind.title: Science lab
kind.body: Labs on two floors around a glass roof.

kind.title: Park
kind.body: A pond, shady trees and a walking loop.

kind.text: Open with a click or the keyboard
Hold a title and one sentence
Pick a colour and an icon
You'll use this map again in the quiz.

slides.notes: Markers open a small pop-up with a title and a sentence. The learner opens them in any order.

kind.alt: A learner thinks about a question, surrounded by answer cards.

question.prompt: Which one shows extra content on top of a slide without leaving it?

kind.text: Yes. Layers sit on top of their slide.
Not quite. A layer shows content on top of the slide you're on.

kind.alt: A learner thinks about a question, surrounded by answer cards.

question.prompt: True or false: a trigger can react when a video ends.

kind.text: True. That's how the video stop showed its message.
It can. A media ends trigger reacts to the end of a video.

kind.alt: A learner thinks about a question, surrounded by answer cards.

question.prompt: Type the missing word: a ________ remembers a value, like the counter on stop 2.

kind.text: Not quite. The answer is variable.

kind.alt: A learner thinks about a question, surrounded by answer cards.

question.prompt: Match each feature to what it does.

pairs.right: Runs an action when something happens
Opens a pop-up on a picture

kind.text: Not quite. Check the pairs and try again.

kind.alt: The campus map: library top left, cafe top right, science lab bottom left, park bottom right.

kind.text: The library has a dome and a wide staircase. You saw it on stop 4.

question.prompt: On the campus map, select the library.

kind.text: Not quite. The library has the dome, top left.

question.prompt: Drag each item into the right group.

kind.text: Not quite. Videos and sounds are media; the rest are questions.
